summary: Nanobiotix S.A., a French foreign private issuer listed on Euronext Paris and Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release disclosing monthly voting rights and share capital as of August 31, 2026. The filing reports 50,941,528 shares outstanding, 54,701,246 theoretical gross voting rights and 54,679,128 exercisable voting rights, published under French Commercial Code Article L.233-8 II and AMF General Regulation Article 223-16. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is present; this is a routine statutory disclosure supporting threshold-crossing monitoring, not a special situation.
